lines.en: One step across an entire wheat field.
The ground sinks beneath my feet.
I walk slowly; my shadow is long.
Roofs are too low; I break through them.
These legs should have stopped long ago.

lines.zh: 村庄的钟，还没我脚踝高。
lines.en: The village bell barely reaches my ankle.
Every step lands like a drumbeat.

lines.zh: 我踩着树冠过去，树断了。
lines.en: I walk over treetops; they snap.

lines.zh: 走了很久，也没走到边界。
lines.en: So long a walk, and no edge yet.

lines.zh: 我的脚步声，山谷先听见。
lines.en: The valley hears my footsteps first.
Who built the road this narrow?
Slow steps; no one waits for me anyway.
I stand, and clouds pass my shoulder.

lines.zh: 这世界没有给我留位置。
lines.en: This world never gave me a place.

lines.zh: 亮度八以下，又十一以上。
lines.en: Light below eight, and above eleven.
So I was never meant to appear.
I count the days and lose count.
Wind through my ribs makes a hollow sound.
My skin is grey-green, hard as an old wall.
I raise a hand and block out the sun.

lines.zh: 没人唤我，我就一直站着。
lines.en: No one calls; so I keep standing.

lines.zh: 我记得很多年前的一片平原。
lines.en: I remember a plain from many years ago.
You reach only my knee.
Your hat fell while you looked up.

lines.zh: 我不认识你，但我认得恐惧。
lines.en: I do not know you, but I know fear.

lines.zh: 你的火把，照不亮我的脸。
lines.en: Your torch cannot light my face.
In your eyes I am a tower.

lines.zh: 你退后了两步，我看见了。
lines.en: You stepped back twice. I saw.

lines.zh: 别举着剑发抖，我看得清。
lines.en: Do not hold that sword shaking; I see it.
I would bow my head, but my neck is stiff.

lines.zh: 你是我见过的第一个活人。
lines.en: You are the first living soul I have seen.
Look at me, and remember I existed.
You cut my toe.

lines.zh: 这么小的伤口，我差点没察觉。
lines.en: So small a wound I nearly missed it.
My hide is thick; your blade is notched.
It hurts, but I am still standing.

lines.zh: 别在同一个地方砍两次。
lines.en: Do not strike the same spot twice.

lines.zh: 伤口流出的不是血，是灰。
lines.en: What seeps from the wound is ash, not blood.

lines.zh: 我退了一步，震倒三棵树。
lines.en: I step back and knock down three trees.
It has been long since anything hurt me.
Your arrows are like mosquito bites.
I look down for you, and you have fled.

lines.zh: 没有食物能引我挪一步。
lines.en: No food can move me one step.
You hold up wheat? I do not understand.
I am this big; nothing fills me.

lines.zh: 发光的东西，我也懒得追。
lines.en: Even glowing things are not worth chasing.

lines.zh: 别拿胡萝卜在我眼前晃。
lines.en: Do not wave carrots before my eyes.
What I want, none of you can give.

lines.zh: 用声音引我？我只听见脚步。
lines.en: Lure me with noise? I hear only steps.

lines.zh: 金子在地上，我也不弯腰。
lines.en: Gold on the ground, and I will not bend.

lines.zh: 曾经有过诱惑，很久以前。
lines.en: There was temptation once, long ago.

lines.zh: 我停在这里，不是被什么吸引。
lines.en: I stand here, drawn by nothing.
You hit my leg and bounced away.

lines.zh: 刚才那一下，我几乎没感觉。
lines.en: I barely felt that.
Do not stand where I put my feet.
You are like a small pebble.
I shift half a step to let you pass.
Bone on bone, a dull sound.

lines.zh: 你的盔甲在我这儿没用。
lines.en: Your armor means nothing at my size.

lines.zh: 别推，我推不动也停不住。
lines.en: Do not push; I cannot be moved or stopped.
I stepped on your shadow. Sorry.

lines.zh: 这么近，你听见我关节响吗？
lines.en: This close, do you hear my joints creak?
There is no second of me in the world.
Kin? I searched for many years.

lines.zh: 没有谁能和我并肩站着。
lines.en: No one can stand at my side.

lines.zh: 我若孤单，也是最大的孤单。
lines.en: If I am lonely, it is the largest loneliness.

lines.zh: 就算有另一个，也进不来。
lines.en: Even another could not get in.
This body has no continuation.
Even my shadow comes only one.
Do not seek me a partner; none exists.

lines.zh: 空旷的原野，只装得下我。
lines.en: The empty plain holds only me.

lines.zh: 很久以前，也许有过同伴。
lines.en: Long ago, perhaps, there was a companion.
Things are too small for me to pinch.

lines.zh: 我低头看，那枚硬币不见了。
lines.en: I look down; that coin is gone.
Whatever I hold crumbles in my grip.
I do not pick things up; I could not see them.

lines.zh: 你们掉的东西，像灰一样。
lines.en: What you drop looks like dust to me.
That sword on the ground looks like a needle.

lines.zh: 我弯不下腰，关节卡住了。
lines.en: I cannot bend; my joints lock.

lines.zh: 有东西掉进我的脚印里。
lines.en: Something fell into my footprint.

lines.zh: 就算捡起来，也没口袋放。
lines.en: Even picked up, I have no pocket.
It sits between my fingers like a grain of sand.

lines.zh: 你抬头的那一瞬，我决定踩下去。
lines.en: The moment you looked up, I chose to stomp.

lines.zh: 这双眼里，你只占一个点。
lines.en: In these eyes you are a single dot.
Run; my one step equals your ten.

lines.zh: 我锁定你了，城门也拦不住。
lines.en: I have you; even the gate will not stop me.

lines.zh: 很久没有东西值得我低头。
lines.en: Nothing has been worth my looking down in ages.

lines.zh: 你身上的光，夜里太显眼。
lines.en: Your light is too obvious at night.

lines.zh: 巨人的手，抓住就是压碎。
lines.en: A giant's hand: to grasp is to crush.

lines.zh: 我听到你脚下的木板在响。
lines.en: I hear the planks creaking under you.
The target is small, but enough.

lines.zh: 别躲进树林，我连树一起踩。
lines.en: Do not hide in the woods; I tread the trees too.
I choose you because you did not run.

lines.zh: 这个距离，我一伸手就到。
lines.en: At this distance, one reach is enough.

lines.zh: 我停住脚步，只是先看看你。
lines.en: I stop walking only to look at you first.
Once locked, I do not change my mind.

lines.zh: 你站在我的影子里，别动。
lines.en: You're standing in my shadow. Stay still.

lines.zh: 我把你从地面上认出来了。
lines.en: I picked you out from the ground below.
I lift my foot; shadow covers you.
Wherever you run, my shadow arrives first.

lines.zh: 我慢慢抬手，你还有时间。
lines.en: I raise my hand slowly; you still have time.

lines.zh: 别站在墙边，墙会跟着倒。
lines.en: Not by the wall; the wall falls with you.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸声，就是倒计时。
lines.en: My breathing is the countdown.

lines.zh: 你举盾的样子，我很熟悉。
lines.en: The way you raise that shield is familiar.
I crouch, and the sky goes dark.
One fist, and the ground is level.
Three seconds left; I do not rush.

lines.zh: 远处的人别过来，我只追一个。
lines.en: Stay back, others; I chase only one.

lines.zh: 我数着你的脚步，一二三。
lines.en: I count your steps: one, two, three.

lines.zh: 关节响了，那是开始的意思。
lines.en: My joints creak: that means it begins.
You stay still, and I am in no hurry.
My hand is already above your head.
I bend down and my bones crack.
Run for the gate. It's far too narrow.

lines.zh: 我一步一步，压平你的路。
lines.en: Step by step I flatten your road.

lines.zh: 你举着火把，像举着根草。
lines.en: You hold a torch like a blade of grass.
I'm waiting for your feet to stop.
When my arm lifts, the wind changes.

lines.zh: 一拍下去，地面裂成两半。
lines.en: One swat and the ground splits in two.
You are flung far away.

lines.zh: 这力道，我自己也收不住。
lines.en: I cannot hold this force back either.

lines.zh: 骨头做的手掌，比铁还沉。
lines.en: A bone palm heavier than iron.
I crush the stone bricks underfoot.
The sound of the hit is very light.
I do not want a second blow.
Still standing after that? Interesting.
This blow is to clear the way.
The air is pushed aside, and so are you.
I pull back my hand; ash drips from the knuckles.

lines.zh: 别靠那么近，我不好控制。
lines.en: Not so close; I am hard to control.
A giant's fist knows no friends.

lines.zh: 打完了，世界安静了一点。
lines.en: Done; the world is a little quieter.
One sweep and the battlements fly off.
The slap of my hand throws you into a tree.

lines.zh: 这一下我听见骨头的声音。
lines.en: That one, I heard the bone.

lines.zh: 我的拳头陷进地里半尺。
lines.en: My fist sinks half a block into the earth.
Still standing? This ground is stubborn.

lines.zh: 我抬手，又放下，算你走运。
lines.en: I raise my hand, then lower it. Lucky you.

lines.zh: 命令念完，我从空中落下。
lines.en: The command spoken, I drop from the air.
I was never born naturally.

lines.zh: 亮度矛盾的那刻，我出现了。
lines.en: At the light contradiction, I appear.

lines.zh: 泥土震了一下，我落地了。
lines.en: The dirt shakes; I land.
My feet touch down, and the trees shrink.
I was meant to be a leftover.
Someone wrote my name down.
I open my eyes; the sky reaches my chest.
This place is too small to hold me.

lines.zh: 我站在这里，像一个错误。
lines.en: I stand here like a mistake.
The bones creak first, then I move.

lines.zh: 又是我，还是只有我一个。
lines.en: Me again, still only me.

lines.zh: 火焰啃着我的旧皮，慢慢的。
lines.en: Flame eats my old hide, slowly.

lines.zh: 脚下塌了，我整个人坠下去。
lines.en: The ground gave way and I fell.

lines.zh: 水只到我腰，却灌进了肺。
lines.en: Water only to my waist, yet it floods my lungs.
A blast at my feet, like a small firecracker.
An arrow sticks in my chest like a thorn.

lines.zh: 药水在我身上，散得太快。
lines.en: Potions fade too fast on a body this large.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，饿也饿不死。
lines.en: I eat nothing, and hunger cannot kill me.
Lightning strikes; I am older than it.

lines.zh: 我掉出世界，脚下空无一物。
lines.en: I fall out of the world; nothing underfoot.
